props.name: fragment
props.description: GLSL ES 1.0 fragment shader with a `void main()`. Do not declare the uniforms — they are prepended: `u_time` (seconds), `u_resolution` (pixels), `u_pointer` (0–1, y up) and one `vec3` per entry in `colors`.

props.name: colors
props.description: Uniform name → CSS colour. Tokens are resolved and re-read when the theme or accent changes.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Render resolution as a fraction of the device pixels. Lower is cheaper; soft shaders lose nothing at 0.5.

props.name: stillTime
props.description: Seconds into the animation to draw when motion is reduced, so the still frame is a good one.

props.name: showErrors
props.description: Show compile errors over the canvas. Useful while writing a shader; errors always reach `onError`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the compile or link log when the shader fails.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when rendering starts, or when it falls back.

props.name: label
props.description: Describe the image for assistive tech. Without it the canvas is decorative and hidden.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn on top of the shader.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give the component a size here.
